content.text:
I fixed it: `v-for` over a `shallowReactive` array now gives you the items as they are, so `item.aaa` stays a ref and the template prints "object object". The existing `renderList` tests pass. I didn't add a test for this case, and I didn't run the issue's reproduction.

**Cause:** in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`, `renderList` wrapped every item with `toReactive` whenever the source array was reactive. It did not check whether the array was shallow. A deep-reactive proxy unwraps refs, so `item.aaa` came back as the string. Reading `shallowReactiveArray[0].aaa` directly doesn't wrap the item, which is why that part already printed "object".

**Fix:** the function now checks `isShallow(source)` and only wraps items when the array is deeply reactive. Shallow arrays are still tracked for reactivity as before.
